plugins.name: credentials-manager
plugins.description: Manage authentication credentials (API keys, tokens, passwords) across Claude Code sessions. Stores credentials in a scope-aware JSON file (project-local when inside a git repo, user-global otherwise) and auto-applies them by URL/domain match.
